heading: Consent-Aware Donor Pool
content: Add, tag, import and search donors with recorded consent status, contact history and preferred channel — with opt-out controls for SMS, WhatsApp and email.

heading: Mobile-Money First
content: Donors give with the payments they already use. Campaign pages open on any smartphone, and the PIN is entered only in the gateway's own approval prompt — never stored or seen by Changia.

heading: Shareable Campaign Links
content: Publish a campaign, generate a short link and QR code, and send approved SMS, WhatsApp or email templates to your consented donor pool in minutes.

heading: Audit-Ready by Design
content: Verified callbacks, idempotent payment handling, integer TZS amounts and immutable audit events keep every shilingi accountable.
